answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the willow queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1813 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the forge. The ripple index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 100 account operation therefore ties up 39 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
